parameters.question: Infer ASVs (DADA2-style) and assign taxonomy (GTDB R07-RS207) to predict whether ASVs are rRNA sequences. Compare ASV sequences and their Kingdom assignments to the reference; column order, row order, and header labels may differ.

Infer ASVs from paired-end amplicon reads and predict whether each ASV is a ribosomal RNA sequence. Match ASVs (by sequence or ID) between files and check that each ASV's rRNA prediction label matches the reference; column order, row order, and header labels may differ.
